_meta.description: Per-service evidence matrix for Phase 7B.5. Each row links to source IDs in sources.v0.1.json. Confidence ratings: HIGH (2+ independent C+ sources converging), MEDIUM (1 C+ + corroborating D), LOW (D-only or single C+).

evidence.label: Ouverture de porte claquée (non verrouillée, cylindre standard)
evidence.description: Door shut without key, pêne engaged but not locked by key turn. Non-destructive opening (picking/radiography). No cylinder replacement required.

labour_range_night_MAD.note: 50% night surcharge on typical day rate

evidence.parts_policy: NONE_REQUIRED — no part replacement in standard case
evidence.notes: Most frequent intervention. Fastest service (5–15 min). Both C+ sources agree on 150–300 MAD day range. mano.ma states 150–250, allo-maison 150–300. Converged lower bound 150, upper 300. Night: 250–500.

evidence.label: Ouverture de porte claquée blindée (non verrouillée)
evidence.description: Armoured/reinforced door, pêne engaged but not key-locked. Requires specialist tooling and expertise. Non-destructive still attempted first.
evidence.condition: Door confirms as blindée, not key-locked
evidence.notes: mano.ma: 250–350 day, 350–500 night. allo-maison: 400–800 for blindée opening (may include locked scenario). Taking conservative 250–400 for claquée-only blindée. If locked: see porte_blindee_verrouillee.

evidence.label: Ouverture de porte verrouillée (clé perdue, clé à l'intérieur)
evidence.description: Door locked by key. May require cylinder drilling and replacement. More complex than claquée. Cylinder replacement is likely outcome.
evidence.condition: Standard door (non-blindée), keys genuinely lost/locked in. Cylinder replacement billed separately if required.
evidence.parts_policy: CYLINDER_REPLACEMENT_LIKELY_SEPARATE — 200–450 MAD for cylinder part+labour billed additionally if destroyed
evidence.notes: mano.ma: 300–450 day, 450–650 night. allo-maison: 300–700. Narrower range at 300–450 for labour component. Cylinder replacement if needed adds 200–450 MAD. Total intervention can reach 500–900 MAD with cylinder.

evidence.label: Ouverture de porte blindée ou multipoints verrouillée
evidence.description: Armoured door locked by key. Specialist tooling. May require drilling and replacement of cylinder or lock mechanism.
evidence.parts_policy: REPLACEMENT_HARDWARE_LIKELY — mechanism/cylinder replacement almost always required after destructive opening; separate quote
evidence.notes: mano.ma: 400–600 day, 600–850 night. allo-maison: 500–1500 day. Wide range reflects variability in blindée complexity, security class. Destructive opening adds parts cost. FIXEO should NOT create a fixed price here — DIAGNOSIS_FIRST with mandatory quote before proceeding.

evidence.label: Extraction de clé cassée dans la serrure
evidence.description: Broken key fragment inside cylinder. Specialist extraction tools. May or may not require cylinder replacement depending on damage.
evidence.condition: Cylinder intact after extraction. If cylinder damaged, cylinder replacement billed separately.
evidence.parts_policy: CONDITIONAL — extraction only: no parts. If cylinder damaged: cylindre_remplacement separate
evidence.notes: mano.ma: 150–300. allo-maison: consistent with this range. Key extraction is a defined, reproducible intervention.

evidence.label: Remplacement de cylindre standard (cylindre européen entrée/milieu de gamme)
evidence.description: Replace standard European cylinder. Labour + standard cylinder part. Client may supply cylinder or artisan supplies with prior approval and disclosed price.
evidence.parts_policy: PARTS_ALWAYS_DISCLOSED — artisan must state brand, spec, price before installation
evidence.notes: Most frequent follow-on from lost keys, break-in or porte verrouillée. Two independent C+ sources confirm 200–500 range including labour + standard cylinder. Higher quality cylinder pushes to 500–800 MAD total. Card de propriété option adds cost.

evidence.label: Remplacement cylindre haute sécurité (breveté, anti-effraction, carte propriété)
evidence.description: High-security cylinder with anti-pick, anti-bump, anti-drill properties. Requires proprietary card for key duplication.
evidence.notes: allo-maison: 700–1500 MAD. mano.ma: 900–2000 MAD for 'haute sécurité' (may include premium brands like Mul-T-Lock). Wide range is legitimate due to brand and security class variation.

evidence.label: Remplacement de serrure complète monopoint standard
evidence.description: Full lock mechanism replacement (not just cylinder). Labour + lock body. Standard 1-point residential lock.
evidence.condition: Standard wooden/metal door, 1-point lock, mechanism accessible
evidence.notes: mano.ma: 400–600 for serrure 1 point. SRC_SERR_004 floor of 100 MAD is parts-excluded or entry-level only. Using 400–700 as honest range including standard part.

evidence.label: Remplacement serrure multipoints (3 points ou plus)
evidence.description: Multi-point lock mechanism replacement. Complex installation. Hardware cost significant.

labour_range_MAD.note: Wide range depending on brand and point count

evidence.notes: mano.ma: 700–1200. allo-maison: consistent. SRC_SERR_004: floor 249 MAD (likely labour only). Significant part cost variation. QUOTE_REQUIRED.

evidence.label: Déblocage / dégrippage serrure grippée
evidence.description: Stiff or seized lock mechanism. Lubrication, adjustment, realignment. Common in coastal cities (Tanger, Agadir) due to humidity and salt.
evidence.condition: Mechanism intact, no part replacement required
evidence.notes: allo-maison mentions 'dégrippage 150 DH vs remplacement 500 DH' in Tanger context. Only one mention. Corroborated by logic. Market practice in coastal cities. Single-source evidence.

evidence.label: Duplication de clé standard
evidence.description: Simple key copy at locksmith or cobbler. Standard key, no security features.
evidence.notes: mano.ma: 30–80. Standard market practice. NOTE: this service is not a FIXEO call-out service — it requires no travel.

evidence.label: Duplication de clé sécurisée / brevetée
evidence.description: Patented key duplication. Requires carte de propriété. Only authorized resellers can copy.
evidence.notes: Single source. Not a standard call-out service. Not a FIXEO pilot candidate as-is.

evidence.label: Installation porte blindée (fourniture + pose)
evidence.description: Supply and installation of new armoured door.
evidence.notes: mano.ma: 2500+ MAD. allo-maison Casa: 3500–8000 MAD. Marrakech (tourist premium): 4500–12000 MAD. Brand (Fichet, Dierre) drives large cost range. QUOTE_REQUIRED.

evidence.label: Sécurisation après effraction / tentative de cambriolage
evidence.description: Emergency securing of premises after break-in. May include temporary securing, cylinder replacement, damaged frame assessment.

labour_range_MAD.note: Highly variable — depends on damage extent

evidence.notes: Both sources mention post-effraction as a common scenario. Pricing not isolated — bundle of cylinder change + possible mechanism replacement + securing. DIAGNOSIS_FIRST is mandatory.
evidence.authorization_note: Police PV should be obtained BEFORE locksmith work to preserve insurance evidence

evidence.label: Ouverture coffre-fort (combinaison oubliée, clé perdue, panne électronique)
evidence.description: Safe opening. Highly specialist. DIAGNOSIS_FIRST always. Authorization verification critical.

labour_range_MAD.note: Estimated — no Moroccan price data found

evidence.notes: No Moroccan price data found. SRC_SERR_005 confirms service exists but devis only. French market equivalent 400–1000 EUR for reference. Safe opening is security-critical — authorization and ownership proof mandatory.

evidence.label: Ouverture portière véhicule (clé enfermée, serrure bloquée)
evidence.description: Vehicle door opening. Older vehicles: simple mechanical; modern vehicles with electronic keys may require specialist reprogramming.
evidence.condition: Older vehicle (pre-2010 equivalent, mechanical lock). Modern vehicle: DIAGNOSIS_FIRST.
evidence.parts_policy: NONE_STANDARD — reprogramming modern keys may have parts/programming cost
evidence.notes: Single Casablanca source (SRC_SERR_003). Older cars 150–300 consistent with porte claquée labour. Modern cars 500–1500 — significant specialist premium. Authorization: vehicle ownership proof recommended.

evidence.label: Installation digicode / serrure connectée / serrure numérique
evidence.description: Electronic keypad or smart lock installation.
evidence.notes: Only generic mention in SRC_SERR_006. Growing market. QUOTE_REQUIRED for hardware variability.

evidence.label: Majoration urgence nuit / week-end / jours fériés
evidence.description: Surcharge applied to any service delivered between 22h–7h, weekends, or public holidays.
evidence.notes: Cross-source consensus: night surcharge is real, expected, and legitimate. Range diverges: mano.ma says 30–50%, allo-maison says 50–100%. Conservative anchor: 50%. FIXEO must NOT approve a canonical surcharge percentage in Phase 7B.5 without human calibration decision.
